admission.justification: A landing closed before both changed sides are published and verified reports a delivery the remote does not hold, and a private board hides the work the sprint claims to show; both misstate delivered work to the reader the board exists for.

applicability: Each refresh event of a published issue (registration, an approved requirement change, a start, a landing, an abandonment) and the Projects board the publication sets up.
conditions: The event happens while the resolved memory carries this file.
exclusions: AR's own transactions, which keep their owners and are not changed here.
A rejected or blocked change, which publishes nothing and keeps the last approved truth.

evidence: Plan operations include both PR-gate rulesets, the landing-workflow controls, the public board title/visibility and the Status-grouped view; no rule-13 public text is in this plan.

statement: Registration, an approved requirement change, a start, a landing and an abandonment refresh the named content; the board is public with a Status-grouped view; landing comments and pull-request prose follow the same public rules while the B/H/M and authority facts stay private.
